sources.title: Transformers library - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: The Transformers library, developed by Hugging Face, is an open source toolkit for working with advanced machine learning models across text, images, audio and multimodal data. It is widely used in NLP, computer vision and generative AI applications. Provides access to pre-trained models. Supports text, image, audio, and multimodal tasks.
